messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 — increased 95th pct latency observed on /v1/generate (hosted) and failover errors to Dedicated. Alerts: `api.latency.95p` firing in us-west-2. Auto-fallback to smaller model triggered. Auto-throttle engaged.

ashley: ack'ing. I'm oncall and pulling this in. seeing ~3x p95, error spike ~5m ago. tracing now.

ben: also seeing similar on Dedicated: queue depth jumped, some RPC timeouts to redis-like cache. rolling back KV cache changes? anyone touched cache config in last 24h?

olivia: no infra changes from infra team. CI shows a model quantization rollout completed ~2h ago for the small chat model but shouldn't affect hosted large models.

raj: copying perf traces — looks like a bad kernel selection on g5p for sequences >2048, causing huge memory pressure and stalls. attaching snippet from perf: ``
GPU stall: kernel conv_attn_v2 slow path triggered
context-switches up 3x
``

ashley: good catch. mitigation plan: 1) route traffic away from g5p pool -> smaller model variants in other pool (already auto-fallbacked) 2) scale up fallback pool by adding 2 nodes 3) disable problematic kernel selection heuristic until patch. I'll start 1 and 2 now.

tom: starting scale up now. `rb scale nodepool fallback-pool +2 --region us-west-2`

ashley: routed ~60% of new requests off g5p within 2m. p95 dropping but still above SLO. continuing.

incident-bot: Paging: @oncall-team paged 1 member (ashley). Noted in channel. Follow the oncall runbook: https://internal/runbooks/latency-spike (link)

sophie: support triage: about 14 customers affected with elevated response times; two reported transient 5xx. Notifying enterprise customers in progress — sending an advisory to accounts affected.

ben: notifying prod to check canary and throttles. I will open a tracker ticket for customer-impacted requests (JIRA RED-1234).

ashley: action: I've disabled the kernel heuristic on the control plane for g5p. monitoring for regressions.

olivia: kernel patch queued — engineering will validate tomorrow's build. For now we should tune alerts to avoid noisy paging while this is stabilizing.

raj: agree. Proposed alert tuning: increase `api.latency.95p` threshold by 20% for the next 90 minutes and add a new alert `api.latency.backend-stalls` that looks at GPU stall metric. Also add a suppression rule for auto-fallback-trigger events that currently create duplicate pages. Sample alert snippet: 

```
- alert: APILatency95p
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.8
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    runbook: /runbooks/api-latency
```

ashley: I can push the temporary threshold change and suppression for fallback pages. But let's keep paging for `backend-stalls` as high severity.

tom: pushed threshold bump and suppression. will monitor for missed pages and revert later.

sophie: customer comms sent to the 14 impacted customers. one enterprise account asked for RCA ETA — telling them preliminary postmortem tomorrow.

ashley: handing off to raj for post-incident ops and full postmortem. raj, can you take ownership of the write-up and action tracking?

raj: taking it. I'll schedule the postmortem in #postmortems for 24h from now and link the incident ticket. Key items I'll include: root cause (kernel selection + memory pressure), why auto-fallback didn't fully protect Dedicated, and missed alert signals.

ben: suggested action items: 1) add GPU stall metric to dashboards, 2) add canary test that exercises seq >2048 paths daily, 3) refine fallback suppression so it doesn't hide real pages, 4) postmortem owner to create follow-ups in JIRA and link to ops board.

ashley: quick wins: tune SLO alert windows (from 5m -> 10m) for p95 to reduce transient noise; add a temporary dashboard for `gpu_kernel_slow_path` and add it to the oncall rotation view.

raj: noted. I'll assign owners and due dates in the postmortem doc. Please add any other items to the thread.

olivia: infra will backport the kernel heuristic patch to the stable runtime image and run validation tomorrow. estimate 48h for full rollout.

sophie: support will follow up with customers once the postmortem is published and confirm if any customers need credits or SLA remediation.

ashley: thanks team. I'll mark incident as mitigated in 15m if p95 stays below temporary threshold. Leaving thread open for postmortem links and action item updates. :white_check_mark:
